roadmap.meta_description: What's shipped, in progress, and planned for NeuroCanvas — the AI-powered infinite canvas for mind mapping.
roadmap.title: Where NeuroCanvas is headed
roadmap.subtitle: A living plan for the canvas — what's already shipped, what we're building now, and what's on the horizon. Built in the open by one developer.

shipped.title: The foundation
shipped.description: Everything that makes NeuroCanvas a complete thinking tool today.
items: Infinite canvas with smooth pan, zoom, minimap and level-of-detail rendering
AI map generation and smart node expansion across OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama and custom providers
Semantic field visualization powered by on-device embeddings
Template gallery with AI generation and one-click adaptation
Cross-device sync with conflict resolution and version history
Accounts, OAuth, two-factor auth and an encrypted credential vault
Share links and export to JSON, PNG and Markdown
Dark and light themes, English and Croatian

now.title: Building now
now.description: Active work landing over the coming weeks.
items: Real-time multiplayer — live cursors, presence and shared editing
Version history restore with visual diffing between snapshots
Desktop (Tauri) and mobile (Capacitor) hardening from beta toward stable
On-device local LLM inference for private, offline embeddings

next.title: Up next
next.description: Committed features queued behind current work.
items: Document RAG — upload PDFs and notes, then chat with your maps via hybrid pgvector search
More interface languages — German, French and Spanish
Richer export — PDF, SVG and a presenter mode
New node types and freeform drawing on the canvas

later.title: On the horizon
later.description: Ideas we're researching. No dates yet — your feedback shapes what ships.
items: Public API and a plugin system for community extensions
Offline-first sync that resolves the moment you reconnect
Team workspaces with shared template libraries
Native mobile gestures and Apple Pencil support

cta.title: Have something you want to see?
cta.body: This roadmap is shaped by the people who use NeuroCanvas. Tell us what matters.

roadmap.disclaimer: Plans change. This page reflects current intent, not a guarantee — features may shift as we learn.
